jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs_results.description: Dash0 is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer in Warsaw. You will build complex data visualization interfaces for our observability platform using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS. Strong product collaboration, accessibility, and design systems experience required. Hybrid work model with an office in Warsaw. 5+ years of frontend engineering experience.

jobs_results.title: Junior React Developer
jobs_results.description: We are looking for a Junior React Developer to join our Warsaw team. You will learn from senior engineers and work on our web application. Basic JavaScript knowledge required.

jobs_results.title: Python Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description: DataCorp is hiring a Python Backend Engineer to build data pipelines and internal APIs. You will work with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes. Experience with distributed systems required.

jobs_results.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs_results.description: RemoteCo is a fully remote company hiring a Frontend Engineer anywhere in Europe. Salary range 90000-110000 EUR per year.
